# Beacon

> Schiphol wayfinding visual identity. Part of The Collective Style Guide Library.

Wayfinding clarity, signage yellow `#FFCC00`, near-black ink, sharp corners, Frutiger-lineage humanist sans. Voice is instructive and directional.

## Use this variant for

Operations dashboards, deep navigation hierarchies, transit / logistics products, anywhere users must orient before acting.

## Modes & densities

- Modes: `light`, `dark`. Densities: `comfortable`, `compact`. RTL: supported.

## Quick token reference (light)

- bg: #FFFFFF / surface: #FFFFFF / text: #1B1B1B / border: #1B1B1B
- accent: #FFCC00 (signage yellow), with #000000 text on yellow
- radius: 0 / sans: frutiger

## Resources

- [Tokens](./tokens.json) / [Principles](./principles.md) / [Content](./content.md) / [Motion](./motion.md) / [i18n](./i18n.md) / [Starter prompt](./starter-prompt.md) / [Components](./components.json)

## Install

```ts
import { theme } from "@collective/beacon";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@collective/foundation";
<ThemeProvider theme={theme}><YourApp /></ThemeProvider>
```
